services.name: Our Classes
services.desc: The most up-to-date schedule changes can be found on this page and on the class schedule on mbo (Mindbody). We do our best to create both a relaxed space to feel grounded and safe space to feed the courage needed to heal and grow. We offer myriad styles and methods of practice, taught by a great variety of incredible teachers, and you are welcome to try them all to find what resonates with you now. We offer a variety of classes with our talented and engaging teachers. We encourage you to come try them all. Please bring your own mat and register ahead of time if possible for all classes.
